english translation text: THE MOURNERS OF THE OPPRESSED ONES OF KARBALA HAVE COME

arabic text: ZAINAB BAREHNA SAR JO BAZAAR AAGAYI.
english translation text: ZAINAB (A.S) HAS COME TO THE MARKET PLACE WITHOUT HER VEIL

arabic text: KHUTBAI PERHUN GI AASAI KAI DUSHMAN BHI HONGAI DAN\nTALWAAR KAI BAGHAIR LARUN GI MAIN AISI JANG
english translation text: I WILL FIGHT SUCH A BATTLE WITHOUT ANY SWORD\nI WILL RECITE SUCH A SERMON THAT EVEN THE ENEMIES WILL BE ASTOUNDED

arabic text: DEKHO HUSSAIN TUM BHI HAMARAI JIHAD KO\nZAINAB HAI AJ BAN KAI ALAMDAR AAGAYI.
english translation text: O HUSSAIN! LOOK AT OUR JIHAD\nZAINAB HAS BECOME THE FLAG BEARER TODAY

arabic text: ZAINAB NAI ZINDAGI MAIN NA DEKHI KOI KHUSHI\nROTI HUWI WOH SHAAM KI RAHON MAI MER GAYI
english translation text: ZAINAB HAS NOT SEEN ANY HAPPINESS\nSHE LEFT THIS WORLD CRYING ON THE STREET OF SHAM

arabic text: TANHA LAHAD MAIN BHAI KO RONAI KAI WASTAI\nSARKAARAI PANJETAN KI WOH GHAM-KHAAR AAGAYI.
english translation text: TO CRY ALONE AT HER BROTHERS GRAVE\nTHE MOURNER (A.S) OF THE PANJETAN HAS COME

arabic text: JIS KI HAYAA SAI SURAJ NAI KHUD KO CHUPA LIYA\nUMMAT SHAKI NAI QAIDI USSI KO BANA LIYA
english translation text: THE ONE FOR WHO'S MODESTY EVEN THE SUN HID ITSELF\nTHE ONE WHOM THE UMMAH HAS MADE PRISONER

arabic text: CHADAR LUTA KAI QAAFILA SALAAR AAGAYI\nKARBOBALA KAI DASHT SAI BAZAAR-E-SHAAM MAIN
english translation text: FROM THE DESERT OF THE KARBALA TO THE MARKET PLACE OF SHAM\nTHE LEADER OF THE CARAVAN HAS COME WITHOUT HER VEIL

arabic text: MEHSHAR KAI ROZ AAYENGI JAB NAIB E BATOOL\nTANVEER YEH KAHAI GAIN KHUDA SAI MERAI RASOOL
english translation text: WHEN THE REPRESENTATIVE OF SYEDA BATOOL (AS) WILL COME ON THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT\nO LORD!, THE PROPHET OF ISLAM WILL SAY

arabic text: ZINDA RAKHAI HAI JIS NAI IRAADAI HUSSAIN KAI\nYA RAB WOH MERAI DEEN KI MADAD GAAR AAGAYI
english translation text: THE ONE WHO HAS KEPT THE RESOLUTION OF HUSSAIN (A.S)\nO LORD! THE HELPER OF MY RELIGION HAS COME
